name: v73_issuance_subindustry_residual
hypothesis: Ranking new-stock-issuance pressure within subindustry may isolate idiosyncratic financing pressure while reducing overlap with the v72 industry-ranked ACTIVE.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * stock_issued_new_issues_value / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(stock_issued_new_issues_value / assets, 252), 126), subindustry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * common_stock_issuance_proceeds / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_90_days, 126), industry)
notes: Peer-axis change plus a small related issuance confirmation; strict corr gate against 1Y7jgeXX.

name: v73_issuance_change_dominant
hypothesis: Falling issuance pressure may be more incremental than static low issuance and less correlated to the v72 level signal.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(stock_issued_new_issues_value / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * stock_issued_new_issues_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(common_stock_issuance_proceeds / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Change-dominant issuance relief; only useful if corr to 1Y7jgeXX falls materially.

name: v73_issuance_without_level
hypothesis: Removing the static issuance level may avoid becoming a direct sibling while retaining improvement in financing pressure.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(stock_issued_new_issues_value / assets, 252), 126), subindustry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(common_stock_issuance_proceeds_2 / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(stock_issued_new_issues_value) / cap, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Mostly change/normalization variant; risk of unit warning from cap is acceptable as a one-time probe.

name: v73_issuance_risk_regime_only
hypothesis: New issuance pressure may matter most when market and idiosyncratic risk are not rising; this tests a lower-signal, stronger-regime version.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * stock_issued_new_issues_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(stock_issued_new_issues_value / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_90_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Lower signal weight to test whether risk-regime conditioning creates a separate sleeve.
